messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-03-16, the catalog service deploys on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-16 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-16]
    earlier: The catalog service only ships on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-24 to 2026-03-16; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-24]
- As of 2026-03-03, storage for the resizer's original uploads doubled in six months. [valid 2026-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-03]
- As of 2025-12-01, the resizer is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from the Ember team. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-01-image-resizer]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-29, the resizer is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-04-29 to 2025-12-01; recorded by handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer]
    earlier: The resizer lives with Team Dune. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-04-29; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- On 2025-05-19, Team Cinder noticed the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-05-19 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-19-2]
- As of 2026-03-03, Team Dune decided the resizer will keep original uploads for only 90 days. [decision; valid 2026-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-03]
- The catalog service relies on the resizer for thumbnails, so if the resizer is down, the catalog service is down. [valid 2025-04-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-15]
- On 2025-12-17, Team Dune decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write. [decision; valid 2025-12-17 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-17]
- As of 2025-04-04, the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table. [decision; valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-04]
- On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-03-2]
- On 2026-01-01, Team Cinder noticed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-01-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-01]
- As of 2026-05-04, Team Boreal still owns the catalog service. [valid 2026-05-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-04]
- On 2025-08-29, Team Atlas observed that the catalog service's request volume halved after the client rollout. [valid 2025-08-29 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-08-29]
- The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents. [valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-28]
- On 2026-03-19, the Ember team noticed that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19-2]
- The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes. [valid 2025-08-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-27]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- As of 2025-06-16, dashboards and alerts for the catalog service are being repointed. [valid 2025-06-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-16-catalog]
- On 2025-05-08, Team Boreal flagged that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, noting the catalog service is not their service. [valid 2025-05-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-08]
- Team Atlas flagged on 2025-04-18 that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2025-04-18 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-18-2]
- On 2025-12-23, Team Atlas noticed that the billing service's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-23]

Question: Which note first recorded that the catalog depends on image-resizer, and when?
